> 第十章 再遇胖子（第1页）

在四周寻找了一会，林铮来到来时的那条诡异的小河旁边，水却已然干涸，仿若从未出现过一般，林铮四周打探，向着进洞的方向走去，那幽不可测的洞口已经完全塌陷，碎石堆上零零乱乱的树木东歪西扭的散落！不过林铮在乱石堆里竟然发现自己来时所准备的包裹，取出来发现里面还有之前准备的一些生活物品！不过食物之类已经被压扁，倒是几件衣物虽沾满泥土却无破损，比起身上这一身破碎布条好多了，林铮连忙换好衣物，又把此次考核的幽冥草贴身放好，四周打探一下却没有什么收获，算下时间距离结束也没有几个时辰了，收敛心思，林铮运足功法便急忙往回赶去！穿过浓雾的时候林铮发现不少同门的尸首，却没有其他意外，通过也极为顺畅！不过出来之时发现浓雾的入口有过很多人聚集的痕迹。莫非这次考核的物品很多存于这浓雾之中，又或者需要穿过这片浓雾？林铮暗自思索不得头绪，殊不知这些人都是冲着他进入山洞内所引发的异象而来！一路上林铮没有丝毫停留，体内的灵气缓缓游动，四肢说不出的舒畅，一扫来时的小心，直线通往门派聚集的场所！十万大山的外围，从大山中出来的众人三三两两的聚在一起，人数明显比来时的数目少了许多了，众人一边低声探讨这十日所遇到的经历，一边暗自提防周围的人们！“哈哈终于出来了，胖子我可不是这么容易就被困在着大山里的！”一阵大笑声，数道人影丛林中闪过，竟是胖子一众人，众人面容憔悴却精神饱满，一个个面带笑意，看来这次考核前两关对众人来说已经是通过了！在外围等待的众人看到胖子一伙，脸上有羡慕有不屑有阴狠，种种目光聚在一伙人身上！不过胖子毫不在意种种目光，一行人径自占据一块地带暗自修养，等待门派之中将传送门再次打开！此时胖子从众人中站立出来，笑眯眯的和众人打着招呼，虽说平日里大家关系不是很好，但是胖子与众人也不交恶，胖子从怀中拿出大把的回原丹毫不客气的送给平日里关系过的去的众人，平日子看待胖子不顺眼的一些人，此时的目光却也退去了敌意，胖子乐呵呵的在众人间走了一圈，然后施施然的回到自己的圈子里与众人交流此次的心得！蓦然，胖子又站起身来，在众人中看了一遍，却没有发现林铮的身影，连忙起身四下询问，却没有一人得知林铮的下落！此时数道人影又从林中闪出，众人面色一凝仔细观察出现的人们，希望从来人的脸上辨别是否是自己失散的好友，又或者来人是否获得了任务品，毕竟还有奉上！今天依旧三章！求点击！求推广！求红票！感谢宝剑大大的章推！

> Chapter 10 Meeting Fatty Again (Page 1)
After searching around for a while, Lin Zheng came to the strange river where he came from, but the water had dried up, as if it had never appeared before. Lin Zheng looked around and walked towards the direction of the cave. The unpredictable cave entrance had completely collapsed, and scattered trees were scattered on the rubble! However, Lin Zheng found the package he had prepared when he came in the pile of rubble. He took it out and found that there were some daily necessities inside! However, the food and the like had been crushed, but a few pieces of clothing were stained with mud but not damaged, which was much better than the torn cloth strips on his body. Lin Zheng quickly changed his clothes and put the Netherworld Grass for this assessment close to his body. He looked around but found nothing. Calculating that there were only a few hours left until the end, Lin Zheng gathered his thoughts and hurried back with all his skills! When walking through the thick fog, Lin Zheng found many corpses of his fellow disciples, but there were no other accidents and the passage was extremely smooth! However, when I came out, I found that there were traces of many people gathering at the entrance of the thick fog. Could it be that many of the items for this assessment are stored in this thick fog, or do they need to pass through this thick fog? Lin Zheng was thinking secretly and had no clue, but he didn't know that these people were all coming for the vision caused by him entering the cave! Lin Zheng didn't stop at all along the way. The spiritual energy in his body swam slowly, and his limbs felt indescribably comfortable. With a careful sweep, he led straight to the gathering place of the sect! On the outskirts of Shiwan Mountain, people who came out of the mountain gathered together in twos and threes. The number of people was obviously much smaller than when they came. While everyone was discussing in low voices the experiences they had encountered in the past ten days, they were secretly wary of the people around them! "Haha, we are finally out. Fatty, I am not trapped in the mountains so easily!" There was a burst of laughter, and several silhouettes flashed through the jungle, and it turned out to be Fatty and a group of people. They all looked haggard but full of energy, and everyone was smiling. It seems that everyone has passed the first two levels of this assessment! The people waiting outside saw the fat man's group, with envy, disdain, and viciousness on their faces, and all kinds of eyes were focused on this group of people! However, the fat man didn't care about all the looks, and the group occupied an area to cultivate in secret, waiting for the sect to open the portal again! At this time, the fat man stood up from the crowd and greeted everyone with a smile. Although the relationship between everyone was not very good on weekdays, the fat man did not have any bad relations with anyone. The fat man took out a large number of Huiyuan Pills from his arms and gave them to Guan Zhouli without any courtesy. The people who had gone there, who usually looked at Fatty with displeasure, lost their hostility in their eyes. Fatty happily walked around among the people, and then returned to his own circle to share his experiences with everyone! Suddenly, the fat man stood up again and looked around in the crowd, but did not find Lin Zheng. He quickly stood up and asked around, but no one knew Lin Zheng's whereabouts! At this time, several figures flashed out of the forest again. Everyone looked carefully at the people who appeared, hoping to tell whether the stranger's face was their lost friend, or whether the stranger had obtained the mission item.
